messages.subject: Recent updates to Rattle (Version 2.2.72)
messages.body_plain:
There has been some recent updates to Rattle that I thought might be
useful to flag to the mailing list. Overal details are available from

  http://rattle.togaware.com/

An updated version will be released through CRAN soon, but as always,
the latest version is available with:

  > install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com")

Or else you can download it directly from:

  http://rattle.togaware.com/src/contrib/rattle_2.2.72.tar.gz

and then

  $ R CMD INSTALL rattle_2.2.72.tar.gz

The main updates have been around the Transform Tab, providing a
number of common pre-processing options (normalisation, imputation). A
growing description is available from:

  http://datamining.togaware.com/survivor/Transform.html

(or else from the draft PDF of the book under development - see the
footer of the web page).

The use of the "tune" function is also being incorporated to
automatically find the best parameter settings. An experimental use is
available with the decision tree model builder.

As always, contributions of code are most welcome, as are comments and
suggestions.

Regards,
Graham

messages.body_plain:
Hi Ernesto,

Michael Lawrence (author of RGtk2) has pointed me to the fact that R
has introduced some fancy quote handling:

Received Tue 27 Nov 2007 11:58pm +1100 from Michael Lawrence:
> Looks like this is the problem:
>
>  o    dQuote() and sQuote() are more flexible, with rendering
>       controlled by the new option 'useFancyQuotes'.  This includes
>       the ability to have TeX-style rendering and directional quotes
>       (the so-called 'smart quotes') on Windows.  The default is to
>       use directional quotes in UTF-8 locales (as before) and in the
>       Rgui console on Windows (new).
>
>
>
> I wonder what his setting is for:
>
> options("useFancyQuotes")
>
> If you set it to "UTF-8" it should work as on Linux. The default locale
> ("C") locale on Windows does not use Unicode for the fancy quotes. UTF-8 is
> required by GTK+. This is a major annoyance.

A quick fix is to run the following in the R window:

> options(useFancyQuotes="utf8")

I'll wrap some function calls in Rattle with this so that inside
Rattle it should work okay (and outside of Rattle the option won't
change - not an ideal solution, but it should work for now).

Thanks again for the bug report.

Regards,
Graham
